lead.title: LightOnOCR-3 folds text recognition and layout extraction into one open model
lead.summary: LightOn released LightOnOCR-3, an open-weights OCR model that combines high-performance text recognition and document layout extraction in a single architecture, published on the Hugging Face hub with full technical evaluation. For local stacks it replaces a common two-model split — a separate OCR model and a separate layout parser — with one document-parsing checkpoint you can run on your own hardware.

top_stories.title: Manus raises over $500M in its first round since the Meta split
top_stories.summary: China's AI-agent startup raised more than $500M led by Boyu Capital and IDG Capital, with Tencent, HSG and ZhenFund participating, reportedly seeking a ~$4B valuation after China forced Meta to unwind its $2B+ acquisition.

top_stories.title: Nous Research raises $90M Series B at a $1.5B valuation for open-source agents
top_stories.summary: The maker of the Hermes open-source AI agents raised $90M led by Robot Ventures, with Nvidia, Union Square Ventures, Menlo Ventures and Samsung participating — total funding now $158M as it pushes toward enterprise local-first agents.

top_stories.title: Model leaderboard Arena nearly doubles its valuation to $3.1B in 10 months
top_stories.summary: The LMArena evaluation platform raised $200M led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Khosla Ventures, with Salesforce Ventures, Dell Technologies Capital, a16z and Felicis among the participants.

items.title: SparseDecoding: pruning LLMs scored on the model's own generated tokens
items.summary: A training-free, layer-wise pruning method that computes importance on self-generated (decoded) tokens rather than natural sequences, closing the distribution-shift gap and cutting memory-bound decoding latency while keeping accuracy.

items.title: Rounding in preconditioner space redesigns 4-bit AdamW optimizer-state quantization
items.summary: Re-derives 4-bit quantization of AdamW optimizer states in preconditioner space instead of state space, reducing adaptive-update perturbation and cutting memory for fine-tuning runs.

items.title: When lower reconstruction loss hurts: robust refinement for low-bit LLM quantization
items.summary: Shows that minimizing reconstruction loss in weight-only PTQ can degrade performance under activation-distribution shift, and proposes a distributionally robust refinement that beats standard low-bit quantization on held-out tasks.

items.title: Where draft trees lose target mass: exit-guided speculative decoding
items.summary: Proves an exit-law bound on accepted block length for tree-based speculative decoding and uses target feedback to improve draft trees for higher acceptance rates.

items.title: RaRaCache reuses the KV cache across models of different sizes
items.summary: Enables KV-cache transfer between different-sized models via rank-disagreement-based selective recomputation, avoiding a full context re-prefill when switching models — a direct serving-cost win for multi-model local stacks.

items.title: JetBrains ships Mellum2.1: a 12B MoE thinking model built for coding sub-agents
items.summary: Released under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face, Mellum2.1 is a 12B mixture-of-experts thinking model activating 2.5B parameters per token with 131K context, trained with reinforcement learning in real repository environments. JetBrains positions it for fast agentic sub-agents that run on your own hardware.

items.title: GLM-5.3-Flash weights go live on Hugging Face while the 744B flagship stays withheld
items.summary: Z.ai's staged GLM-5.3 release has split: the 320B GLM-5.3-Flash (Ox Alpha) variant now ships open weights under MIT, while the promised 744B flagship weights remain unavailable after the two-week safety hold expired. The Flash weights are trending on the Hub.

items.title: Conway Research opens Underdog-Saluki-27B-1.0 under Apache 2.0
items.summary: A new open-weight 27B text-generation checkpoint from a small publisher — a genuinely new mid-size open model in the size class that matters most for local deployment.

items.title: Ollama v0.40.2 upgrades older models in the background for the new llama.cpp runner
items.summary: Models downloaded by older versions are now silently upgraded on first run for better llama.cpp compatibility, with the original copy retained as a disk backup so downgrades stay safe; `ollama list` no longer shows duplicates, and `ollama launch claude` now uses the model's full context length.

items.title: Rembrandt: a free open-source Lightroom alternative with AI that runs entirely locally
items.summary: Show HN launch of a photo editor where editing and AI features run fully on the user's machine with no cloud dependency — the highest-scoring local-AI entry in the Oct 8 Show HN batch.

items.title: Edi Life OS ships an MCP server so agents can reach your self-hosted dashboard
items.summary: A self-hosted personal dashboard covering habits, goals, Kanban, finance and focus that exposes all of its data to AI agents through a built-in MCP server — a practical example of the local-agent-plus-MCP pattern.

items.title: Anvil runs offline LLM chat and SDXL image generation on the iPhone
items.summary: An iOS app that runs offline LLM chat and SDXL image generation entirely on-device, currently distributed via TestFlight — a notable on-device inference-on-iPhone demo, if a small launch.

items.title: n8n 2.43.2 fixes OpenAI-compatible Assistant model providers on self-hosted instances
items.summary: A patch on the 2.43.0 guardrails release that fixes Kimi K3 and other OpenAI-compatible Assistant model providers in self-hosted n8n Assistant, plus an editor fix that shows the Agent artifact while the agent builder creates it.

items.title: llama.cpp builds b11513–b11515 land with SYCL and Hexagon fixes
items.summary: The b11513-b11515 batch adds SYCL Q5_K reorder-layout MMVQ and fused GLU, with fixes for MUSA FWHT shared memory, CUDA PAD kernels over 65,535 rows, and unaligned bias-add fusion on the Hexagon backend.

items.title: Aura: a self-hosted multi-user agent with temporal graph memory and MCP tools
items.summary: A self-hosted multi-user AI agent written in Go featuring temporal graph memory, scheduled jobs, MCP tool support and Telegram/WhatsApp channels, deployed via Docker — a Show HN debut for an April project.

items.title: SK hynix and Samsung push 16-layer HBM4 while Nvidia's Rubin favors 12 stacks
items.summary: Memory makers are developing 16-layer HBM4 stacks while the Nvidia Rubin platform reportedly favors 12-layer configurations — a supply-and-stack-height decision that feeds into GPU pricing during the ongoing DRAM shortage.

items.title: GPU Price Index: tracked cards sell 6.7% below launch MSRP as of Oct 8
items.summary: The videocardprices.com index stood at 93.3 on October 8 — the 22 tracked GPUs with a published MSRP sell 6.7% below launch price on average, amid the memory-driven repricing of local-AI hardware.
